verdict.rationale: Perplexity has official iOS and Android apps (App Store and Play Store listings) with a broad feature set: Pro Search/Deep Research, Assistant tasks, voice, citations, library/history sync across devices, and cross-model access — indicating full-featured rather than bare-bones apps. Missing for 10: independent hands-on app-store review/rating evidence and no direct community commentary specifically on mobile app quality (community feedback cited is about the web/desktop product and Computer feature, not mobile apps specifically).
